UC Berkeley 2023 page: year from "2023 Graduating Doctoral Students" in the title. University of Cincinnati: placements list from the Portfolio 2022 magazine "Doctoral Notes" page with no per-person year; listedYear 2022 is the magazine issue year (yearMeaning unstated); the award winners Liang Shen and Tianhai Zu and the "Lindner's PhD Students" roster are current students and were skipped. University of Florida: table columns Graduation | Student | Placement | Current Job; destination is the Placement column, Current Job kept in note; page footer says last updated March 31, 2022. University of Houston: all-fields doctoral placement table (Accounting, Finance, Management, MIS, Marketing, SCM); Year column is not labelled as graduation or placement year, so yearMeaning is unstated.
